banter.text: {target} just hit concrete. That ball got more solid contact with the path than they got with the club.
{target} bounced one off the cart path. Finally got some extra distance—just nowhere they fucking wanted it.
{target} sent it onto the pavement. Even the ball is trying to take the cart back to the clubhouse.
That’s cart path for {target}. The course gave them acres of grass and they found the fucking road.
{target} caught the path and got a monster bounce. Best part of the shot happened after they stopped controlling it.
{target} hit the cart path. Their ball is following the same strategy as the drinking: get off course and let momentum handle the rest.
{target} hammered the cart path. Their {spouse} is probably pissed the concrete got a harder pounding than anything at home.
